name: 유리 지느러미 쏠배감펭
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: A LIONFISH with red and cream striped body, spectacular large translucent glasslike fan pectoral fins with fine red rays, long dorsal spines, delicate pale blue highlights. Keep fins anatomically readable. Side profile facing LEFT throughout. Maintain cute cartoon foundation.  OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle tail and fin swimming phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
